tasks.title: Create and validate the Unity 6.0 LTS project
tasks.objective: Create a Unity project at the repository root with editor 6000.0.64f1, Built-In Render Pipeline, preserving all bootstrap documentation, and verify batch-mode licensing/logs.
mustNotTouch: Root bootstrap Markdown (except required status updates)
acceptance: Unity project opens with the selected 6000.0.64f1 editor
Built-In Render Pipeline is used; no URP/HDRP package is added
Bootstrap files remain intact
Batch-mode Unity command produces a log and exit code
Any license/activation failure is recorded as a blocker, not hidden
Package manifest and project settings are recorded for approval

checks.name: Project existence
checks.evidence: Assets/ (empty), Packages/, ProjectSettings/ exist at repository root

checks.name: Compile smoke check
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; no error CS/Exception/Shader error matches. TestResults/unity-compile-smoke.log

result.summary: Unity project created at the repository root with editor 6000.0.64f1, Built-In Render Pipeline, and a minimal built-in package baseline plus UGUI/TextMeshPro and Unity Test Framework. Batch launch and compile smoke check both exited 0.
result.notes: The first batch launch failed with exit 198 because the Unity Personal offline license validity period had expired. The human refreshed the license through Unity Hub; the retry succeeded. An unquoted project path caused a stray log file at C:\Users\Asus\Desktop\AI; deletion is blocked by project permissions and requires cleanup approval.

tasks.title: Review and approve baseline package manifest and project settings
tasks.objective: Record the exact package manifest and project settings generated by project creation; remove nothing without approval and add no third-party package.
acceptance: Manifest contains only the agreed baseline packages/built-in modules
Render pipeline is Built-In
Any deviation or package change is presented for human approval
Rollback/checkpoint exists before settings changes

tasks.title: Create folder structure and assembly definitions
tasks.objective: Create the runtime folder structure and runtime/editor/test assembly definitions with no circular dependencies.
acceptance: Feature folders exist under Assets/LaundryLegends
Runtime assembly compiles independently of editor/test assemblies
Test assemblies reference runtime and test framework
No third-party dependency added

tasks.title: Create scenes and build settings
tasks.objective: Create Bootstrap, MainMenu, and Laundromat scenes and register them in build settings with Bootstrap first.
acceptance: Scenes open without missing scripts
Build settings include all three scenes
Bootstrap is index 0
No unrelated project settings changed

tasks.title: Implement minimal GameState and scene routing
tasks.objective: Implement a simple persistent GameState foundation and route from Bootstrap to MainMenu/Laundromat.
acceptance: Bootstrap initializes services without errors
Scene routing reaches MainMenu and Laundromat
No static mutable global money/order state
GameState lifetime is documented

tasks.title: Implement first-person movement, camera, and interaction stub
tasks.objective: Add first-person character movement, mouse look, cursor lock/release, and a raycast interaction stub using the legacy Input Manager.
acceptance: Player moves and looks smoothly
Esc opens a minimal pause overlay and releases the cursor; Resume closes it and locks the cursor
Interaction raycast reports a target in range
No new input package added

tasks.title: Build greybox laundromat environment and lighting
tasks.objective: Create a readable greybox room with floor, walls, entrance, counter, machine wall, folding area, and basic lighting.
acceptance: Player can walk the room without falling through geometry
Scale reads correctly for a person, counter, and machines
Critical paths have collision
Lighting reveals interaction surfaces
Secret access is foreshadowed but not open

tasks.title: Add test scaffolding and batch validation commands
tasks.objective: Add EditMode/PlayMode test scaffolding and document reproducible batch-mode compile/test commands.
acceptance: At least one EditMode and one PlayMode test exist
Batch-mode commands are documented and runnable
Results are saved under TestResults/
A deliberately failing check is reported as failed, not skipped

tasks.title: Verify Phase 1 acceptance and record evidence
tasks.objective: Run the full Phase 1 verification, review the diff, update state/docs, and produce the phase-boundary report.
acceptance: All Phase 1 acceptance criteria have evidence or a documented blocker
Human verifies movement, camera, and greybox readability
Git checkpoint is recorded
Project state and next task are updated

checks.name: Full Phase 1 validation
checks.command: Structural + Unity compile + tests + manual playtest
